title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 4: You're Next - A Piece of Cake
content:
Completely LARP coded and unnecessary.

I would be the first to give MhA credit when credit is deserved, but nothing will stop me for calling out bs on the questionable hips and hoops it pulls sometimes. This was was not praise worthy, it was a completer and utter waste of time.

This sits at the intersection of season 7th’s pre-war plot and the 4th movie, it serves as a prelude to the absolute mayhem that takes place in the movie, although, I felt like it was not all that gripping. A bunch of light hearted exchanges between the students and then an All-Might monologue. It goes out of fashion pretty quickly.

Overall: 5.2/10.
